claims.statement: Luke says he investigated events carefully and wrote an orderly account so Theophilus could know the certainty of what he had been taught.
John says he selected signs so readers may believe Jesus is the Messiah, the Son of God, and have life in His name.
Taken together, these passages support the lesson’s big idea: Each Gospel author selected and arranged testimony for a purposeful witness to Jesus.
